about: MB1's 264 quantized encoder layers and the batch-1 M (rows = B*T frames) of the 3, 10 and 30.04 s LibriSpeech test-clean clips used by M1's recorded runs (compare_v2.py, EXPERIMENTS4.md; cuda_experiments.py --rows 38 126 376). Written by gpu1bit/shared/make_shapes.py from one eager CPU forward per clip length.

budget.definition: see gpu1bit/shared/api.py weight_budget_bytes and plans/gpu-kernel.md A5

M_rules.T: every layer except linear_pos: one row per encoder tensor frame (B*T; T = encoder output tensor frames, which can exceed encoded_length by one)
M_rules.2T-1: self_attn.linear_pos projects the relative positional embedding [1, 2T-1, 1024] (batch 1 regardless of B); M1's optimized runtimes compute it eagerly at warm-up and replay a cached result inside CUDA graphs (transforms.py position=True), so it is not in the timed graph

m1_runtime_calls_per_encoder_forward.about: Projection calls M1's optimized/expanded/hybrid encoder (encoder_transform qkv=True, silu=True, norm_quant=True, position=True, layer_fusions) makes per forward inside the graph; Q/K/V run as one fused [3072, 1024] projection.

calls.what: self_attn fused QKV (norm_self_att fused into quantization)
